name: sk-reasoning-block
title: Reasoning Block
description: The collapsible thinking disclosure, showing the line the model is currently on rather than a spinner. Collapsed it costs one line; expanded it is the full trace. When reasoning ends the header settles into the measured duration.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKReasoningBlock(reasoning, isThinking: model.isReasoning)
SKReasoningBlock(reasoning, isThinking: false, duration: 4.2)
